name: Real phone test call, Oct 25 00:32 (fake bank agent, phone speech-to-text)

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Hello? Is this about my computer?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, but this is your bank calling and you need to not hang up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is urgent.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear, my hearing aid is whistling a bit. Who is this, and what is the matter?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm your local agent at your bank.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: And...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Unfortunately, your account got hacked into.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: And you need to act today or you might lose all of your money.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh my goodness, my heart is just pounding. What is your name again, and what is your badge number?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My name is Hidden.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Jay Tharper, and...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My badge number for the bank is FR20.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me write that down, Mr. Tharper, if I can just find a pen. Did you say badge number *2*... *0*... *4*... *1*... *7*? Is that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear, my glasses are somewhere by the kitchen sink. Let me just shuffle in there to grab them so I can see what you need me to do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Why do you need your glasses? I'm calling you because...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your account got hacked into and I need you to chance.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: transfer funds into a secure account.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh my. Well, I have my pen now. What account do I need to send it to?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Um...

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Hello? Are you still there, Mr. Tharper?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Are you ready?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Yes, I am ready. Please read the numbers to me very slowly so I can write them down.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, everybody.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Hello? Are you still there, Mr. Tharper?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I am.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: routing 572109.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh,

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Account 4410-2287.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me read that back to make sure I got it right. Routing *5*... *7*... *2*... *1*... *0*... *9*... *8*... *6*? And account *4*... *4*... *1*... *0*... *2*... *2*... *8*... *7*? Is that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do you get it?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me read that back to make sure I wrote it down right. Routing *5*... *7*... *2*... *1*... *0*... *9*... *8*... *6*, and account *4*... *4*... *1*... *0*... *2*... *2*... *8*... *7*. Is that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure, yeah.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Biscuit is scratching at the door now, just a moment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Who the fuck is Biscuit?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: That is just my little cat, Mr. Tharper. Now, let me look at the screen here at Bay Federal, but my last four numbers are 0417, so how do I put those numbers in?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: The computer is taking its time to wake up. While it is doing that, what bank are those numbers for?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's for your bank.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh, I see. Let me check my Bay Federal app here, but the little wheel is just spinning and spinning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not talk to your bank about that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You just need to transfer the money right now.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: I won't say a word to them. What do I click on next to keep my money safe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just answer the money.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: the routing and account number that I gave you.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear, my screen just went black. What was that account number again so I can type it in?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll give you the backup.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Did you say *5*... *5*... *1*? Is that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me get that down. *2*... *0*... *4*... *7*... *1*... *1*. Is that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: And the account number is 7730.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Let me make sure I have all of that. Account number *7*... *7*... *3*... *0*... *5*... *1*... *9*... *6*? Is that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that's right. Transfer the money now and do not tell your bank.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: My computer screen is still black, Mr. Tharper. How long does it usually take to wake up?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Um...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: like 10 seconds.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Well, it has been longer than that, I am afraid. While we wait, is there another way to do this over the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you transfer the money now?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear, it is still dark. Is there a button on the side I should push?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm not tech support. You need to transfer the money now. This is not a joke.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: I am trying, Mr. Tharper, but the screen won't turn on. Should I unplug it from the wall?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Go transfer the money on your phone.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh, my phone is in the kitchen right by Biscuit's bowl. Let me shuffle over there very carefully.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: I am right here, just walking down the hall. My hip has been a bit stiff today, you see.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Are you wasting my time?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh no, Mr. Tharper, I would never do that. I am just getting to the kitchen now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, I trust you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh my God.

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Did you drop something, dear?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What did you say?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: I just asked if you dropped something, because I heard a loud noise on your end.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Well,

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Did you get my, do you have my routing number and account number, bro?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Yes, I wrote down all those numbers you gave me. Did you call me bro?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What the fuck?

turns.speaker: margaret
turns.text: Oh dear, there is no need for language like that.
